## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

An eight-fascicle Northern Sòng *jì* 記 sub-commentary on **Dàoxuān**'s ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3)) *Sìfēnlǜ shānbǔ suíjī jiémó shū* 四分律刪補隨機羯磨疏 ([KR6k0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0019)) by **Yǔn Kān** 允堪 ([允堪](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%81%E5%A0%AA), 1005–1061). *Zhèngyuán* 正源 ("rectifying the source") signals Yǔn Kān's editorial intent: to restore Dàoxuān's original karman-text commentary against the corruptions and lacunae of the eleventh-century Sòng witnesses.

**Abstract**

The *Zhèngyuán jì* is one of the principal Northern Sòng sub-commentaries on Dàoxuān's karman-text manual ([KR6k0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0019)) and forms — together with Yǔn Kān's *jì* on the *Sìfēnlǜ hánzhù jièběn shū* ([KR6k0144](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0144)) — the core of his contribution to the Sòng Vinaya revival. The work proceeds *piān*-by-*piān* through Dàoxuān's eight chapters (*jífǎ* 集法, *jiéjiè* 結界, *shòufǎ* 受法, *yīyào shòujìng* 衣藥受淨 etc.), reconstructing the text-history and supplying lemmatic glosses on each of Dàoxuān's *kē* divisions. Yǔn Kān's reconstructive philological work was decisive for the later Sòng *Lǜzōng*: his sub-commentary supplied the practical resource that allowed Yuánzhào ([元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7)) and the Língzhīsì 靈芝寺 successors to revive the *Nánshān* tradition in the second half of the eleventh century. Composition cannot be precisely dated within Yǔn Kān's career; the bracket here gives his mature scholarly years (he reached majority around the late-1030s).
